Chapter 6908: The High Heaven Cannot Judge My Sin

Chapter 6908: The High Heaven Cannot Judge My Sin

“Boom!” The trio channeled the karma accumulated from the abyss into the living cauldron.

“Rumble!” The cauldron initiated a maelstrom capable of affecting all of Stygian.

Space and time twisted chaotically as it demanded powers from this dark world.

“Damn!” The other immortals shouted.

“Immortal Devourer, stop your devouring at once, do not use this battle for your personal gains!” God Messenger shouted.

A fool could tell that this abyss existed to devour Stygian. However, Immortal Devourer just wasn’t strong enough to carry this goal yet.

“From Devour to True Immortality!” The maelstrom stopped and swallowed Li Qiye.

Spectators heaved a sigh of relief. This looked like a great beast swallowing a sheep instantly.

“Wait, they swallowed the heart too!” Many immortals realized this.

Guangmai’s expression darkened since this wasn’t a good development.

“Pop!” Suddenly, the abyss was torn apart and Li Qiye walked out, entirely unscathed.

They saw the heart still floating above his head and felt much better. He simply walked out without doing anything, so the immortals from Devouring Abyss were still alive.

“Pitiful.” Li Qiye said: “Waited so long to become a golden immortal, yet still couldn’t be an exception. You buried your own lineages and loved ones.”

Immortal Devourer didn’t say anything since few knew about this past. The world only knew about his struggle and how he never devoured before becoming a golden immortal.

“Immortal Devourer, stand aside.” Guangmai said, not wanting the heart to be potentially taken by someone else: “Controller, you three judge him.”

The three messengers exchanged glances and had to obey. They entered the battlefield and surrounded Li Qiye with a triangular formation.

“Your sins shall be judged.” Controller said.

“Isn’t that amusing, fallen ones accusing others of sin?” Li Qiye said: “If I am guilty of something, then all of you are unforgivable.”

“In the darkness, to have light is to sin.” Controller said.

“I suppose that’s logical.” Li Qiye stroked his chin and said: “Yes, it is a sin to be a flower amidst a field of manure.”

“Dark Judgment!” Controller shouted and the other two followed his lead.

“Buzz.” Stygian became frozen. This affected golden immortals as well since it came too quickly.

The darkness was the highest existence under this phenomenon. All were subjected to its dominion regardless of their mastery over various affinities.

The high heaven was blocked out of the darkness. When judged as a sinner, one would be eradicated regardless of its form.

“Sin!” A supreme judgment descended upon Li Qiye.

“My sin? Not even the high heaven can judge me.” Li Qiye stretched and said.

“Boom!” His words nullified the judgment and the dark phenomenon shattered into pieces, revealing the injured messengers.

He still didn’t do anything, but the judgment couldn’t deliver a sentence. The three messengers vomited blood and stared at him in disbelief.

Guangmai had a serious expression. The other immortals broke out in cold sweat. They have heard about the dark judgment before - the reason why the three messengers could control Stygian for epochs.
